descriptionByLocale.en: Sodexo was founded in 1966 by Pierre Bellon in Marseille and is the world’s leading provider of sustainable company catering and special experiences in all areas of life. With its two divisions Food and Facilities Management Services, Sodexo meets all the challenges of daily life with a dual goal: to improve the quality of life of our employees and the people we serve. Growth and social commitment go hand in hand. Sodexo’s motto is “to create a better everyday for everyone to build a better life for all.” In Switzerland, we are the only provider specialising in facility management and catering services. We pursue a holistic approach for our customers, focusing on infrastructure, people and their well-being as well as the environment. Our approximately 650 employees work in the areas of cleaning, catering, corporate catering, logistics, security and reception services, conference services and technical building management. We always strive to make the everyday life of people in front of and behind the scenes better with our actions and thinking. Would you like to work for one of the largest family businesses in the world? Then become part of our team and apply for this exciting task. Although we are part of a global player, we live in our small team a pronounced “hands-on” mentality. Your contact Do you feel addressed? Then we look forward to your complete application documents via our online portal. With our job advertisements, we appeal to everyone and are committed to diversity and diversity in the company. descriptionByLocale.en: Sodexo was founded in 1966 by Pierre Bellon in Marseille and is the world’s leading provider of sustainable company catering and special experiences in all areas of life. With its two divisions Food and Facilities Management Services, Sodexo meets all the challenges of daily life with a dual goal: to improve the quality of life of our employees and the people we serve. Growth and social commitment go hand in hand. Sodexo’s motto is “to create a better everyday for everyone to build a better life for all.” In Switzerland, we are the only provider specialising in facility management and catering services. We pursue a holistic approach for our customers, focusing on infrastructure, people and their well-being as well as the environment. Our approximately 650 employees work in the areas of cleaning, catering, corporate catering, logistics, security and reception services, conference services and technical building management. We always strive to make the everyday life of people in front of and behind the scenes better with our actions and thinking.
